limits: Actual live main/mirror render invocations, root provider points and HDR ranges; not absolute source/nit calibration, photoreal acceptance or a frame-rate benchmark.
Reference ring seed42/intensity1; wind0 is set externally; actual residual wind is recorded. Exact pause requests differ from fixed20Hz density commits by the normal fraction of a tick.
Cold+22 samples never query an already retired provider; root point validation is restricted to hot+1.1 actual active history.
Forced current SDR PNGs are nonblank-checked; they do not validate the HDR display. Extra mirror witness is labelled as a different camera, not the fixed-pose hide A/B.
No runtime source files are edited. Preferences can be restored; physical time, emitted events and deliberately cleared smoke cannot be rewound.
Centre/root source sparsity, conditional-mean scattering and existing no-self-shadow/volumeDOF limits remain; v1 visual rejection may coexist with passing technical acceptance.
